title: Jung Rhythm
overview:
Play with friends. Compete with rivals. A dance action game with head-to-head battles!

- The player's skill is checked in detail on rating meters such as "Groove", "Rhythm" and "Technique".
- During ad-lib time you can dance freely. Aim for a high score with special moves entered by command!

友達と遊ぶ。ライバルと競う。対戦可能なダンスアクション！

●「ノリ」、「リズム」、「テクニック」など、プレイヤーの腕前は評価メーターで細かくチェック。
●アドリブタイム内は自由にダンスを楽しめる。コマンド入力の必殺技で高得点をねらえ！
